news.headline: Bangladesh presses India before Ganges water treaty expires
news.summary:
<p>With a 30-year Ganges water-sharing treaty with India expiring in December, Bangladesh fears failure to strike a new deal could deepen water shortages, threatening tens of millions of livelihoods.</p>
